correctness.rationale: Alternating iid parity streams for simple walk on K_{n,n} and separately erasing each stream’s consecutive equal symbols produce exact nonbacktracking marginal chains. Conditional on retained chain, discarded repeats are independent geometric-failure counts; the two stream completion times are iid sum_{k=1}^{n-1} Geom(k/(n-1)). Inclusion-exclusion yields the claimed F_n and H_n products. Poisson factorial moments give max(K_A,K_B)/n-log n=>G+log2, while conditional geometric CLT gives repeats (R_*-log n)/sqrt(log n)=>Z, asymptotically independent of max K. The bound sup P(K_n=j)<=1/(n-1) makes late-winner switching probability negligible and gives o(1) correction to the expected saving, proving 2log n+2gamma+2log2+o(1). Independently verified exact stage-CDF identities by rational Markov dynamic programming on n=3,4 with and without loops. The coupling-specific law is explicitly differentiated from coupling-independent mean difference.
residual_risks: No claimed Gaussian law exists for an unspecified joint coupling. Finite Markov checks establish only n=3,4 cases, not n→infinity.
